Table 3. Per-class VQA accuracy: Baseline→Proposed (∆, pp). Landmark color (n = 11) excluded. Abn.=abnormality, Lmk.=landmark, Inst.=instrument.

Fig. 1. Methodology overview. Phase 1 constructs auxiliary datasets via two tracks: GradCAM masks from a GastroNet-5M classifier (abnormalities/landmarks), KvasirSEG expert masks (polyps), and Gemma-27B terminology-free visual descriptions. Phase 2 fine-tunes each backbone jointly on three tasks via QLoRA; only VQA is used at inference.
